settings.body: Works on beach, paddleboard, hot sand, and boat decks. Open-toe design for ground feel, drainage channels for water, and the same injection-molded grip that locks in studio — now engineered for every surface outside it.
Works on beach, paddleboard, hot sand, and boat decks. Always check wet surfaces for slippage.

settings.question: Grippy shoes for beach and hot sand
settings.answer: Hot sand, wet sand, uneven ground — Outdoor grippy shoes protect your feet while maintaining ground feel. Quick-drain design sheds water in seconds.

settings.question: Grippy shoes for boat decks and paddleboarding
settings.answer: Boating and paddleboarding — grip where bare feet slip. Lightweight enough to forget you're wearing them. Always check wet surfaces for slippage.

settings.question: Packable grippy shoes for travel and resortwear
settings.answer: Roll them flat, toss them in your bag. Beach, resort, hotel gym — one pair covers every surface your trip throws at you.

settings.question: How do I care for Outdoor grippy shoes after water use?
settings.answer: Rinse with fresh water, shake out excess, air dry. The injection-molded grip and performance knit are engineered for repeated water exposure — no degradation, no odor buildup.
